# LLM Benchmark (Awesome LLM Benchmarks)

> Evaluating the true agency and performance of AI models through interactive, real-time game loops.

## About the Project
LLM Benchmark is an open-source evaluation platform built by Studio1. We believe that static, multiple-choice benchmarks like MMLU are becoming obsolete due to test-set contamination and the rapid advancement of frontier models. 

Instead of static tests, we evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) using interactive, procedural game loops. Models must generate JavaScript logic in real-time to "play" games like Breakout, Snake, and Flappy Bird within a browser Sandbox. 

## Key Features
- **Interactive Evaluation**: Models are tested on their ability to maintain state, adapt to dynamic changes, and reason spatially.
- **Procedural Generation**: Every benchmark environment is uniquely generated using cryptographic seeds to prevent memorization and overfitting.
- **Full-Stack Reasoning**: Models must handle runtime errors, parse logs, and fix bugs autonomously.
- **Real-Time Execution**: Performance is measured not just in accuracy, but in reaction time and tokens per second (Output Speed).

## Methodologies
- **Elo Rating**: Models are scored using an Elo rating system based on their survival time, bug fixes, and in-game mechanics.
- **Output Speed**: We measure the median tokens/second for code generation.
- **Context Handling**: Benchmarks require deep context retention to ensure the model doesn't forget the layout of the generated environment.

## Resources
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Studio1-OSS/awesome-llm-benchmarks
- **Blog**: Read our insights on scaling laws, context windows, and the death of static benchmarks.
- **Leaderboard**: View the real-time Elo rankings of models like Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, and Llama.

## System Notes
- Open-sourced by Studio1 to democratize AI evaluation.
- Designed with a premium, minimalist aesthetic for optimal user experience.

*We are building the future of agentic evaluation.*
